_comment: Data/Content/course-index.json - the course map the sidebar and landing page read. GENERATED by scripts/import-notebooks.ts alongside the day files.

imported_at._comment: ISO-8601 UTC. When the importer last ran.

source_repo._comment: Absolute path the content was imported from, recorded so a stale import is diagnosable.

available_days._comment: Days not locked - what a learner can actually open today.

theme._comment: Short description of the week, shown on the landing page outline.
